title: What If You Opened All 85 Billion Pokémon Cards?
description:
Pokémon has made over 85 billion cards.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Pok%C3%A9mon Trading Card Game: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Trading_Card_Game

From Wikipedia (Pokémon Trading Card Game): as of March 2026 the game has produced over 85 billion cards worldwide; the PSA 10 Pikachu Illustrator, the most expensive Pokémon card ever sold, was bought for $5,275,000 in July 2021 and sold for $16.5 million in February 2026. Our math: 85 billion seconds is about 2,693 years (365.25-day years), a day has 86,400 seconds; $16.5M / $5.275M is about 3.1. Not financial advice.

#shorts #pokemon #pokemoncards #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you open a pack, remember:
cta: Pikachu or Charizard? Comment your favorite.

scenes.narration: Pokémon has made over 85 billion cards.
Open one every second, nonstop? About 2,700 years.
One full day of opening? Just 86,400 cards.
And one rare card just sold for 16.5 million dollars.
In 2021, that same card sold for 5.3 million. The price tripled.
